Title: Public Preview: Virtual Canary Maintenance Program

Body.Content:
We are excited to introduce the Virtual Canary maintenance program, a new initiative designed to provide you with early access to Azure Database for MySQL maintenance updates. This program empowers you to stay ahead by testing your workloads against new features and updates before they are broadly rolled out. With Virtual Canary, you can ensure compatibility, identify opportunities for optimization, and contribute valuable feedback to shape the future of Azure MySQL. 

  
This program is especially beneficial for nonproduction environments, including servers running in the Burstable service tier, which are automatically enrolled to maximize the advantages of early maintenance cycles. Virtual Canary allows updates to be applied in a phased manner, ensuring a smoother experience while helping to enhance the overall platform stability and performance. 
  
You have full flexibility to manage your participation. If you prefer not to be part of Virtual Canary, opting out is simple and can be done anytime through the Azure CLI. 
  
Discover the benefits of being at the forefront of innovation and contribute to making Azure MySQL even better. Join the Virtual Canary program today and be part of this exciting journey! 

 

Learn more.
